## 获取最新动态

当**罗群**发布新文章、研究笔记或项目时，获取更新通知。 订阅后，请通过收到的邮件链接确认邮箱。 如需变更订阅，请联系 [qunluo.kiwi@gmail.com](mailto:qunluo.kiwi@gmail.com)。

```{=html}
<div class="ql-subscribe-container" style="max-width: 500px; margin: 2rem 0; padding: 2rem; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.03); border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1);">
  <p style="margin-bottom: 1.5rem;">请在下方输入邮箱以订阅：</p>
  
  <input type="email" id="ql-subscribe-email" aria-label="电子邮箱" placeholder="请输入电子邮箱" style="width: 100%; padding: 0.75rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.3); border-radius: 6px; box-sizing: border-box;" required>
  
  <div class="ql-turnstile-box" style="margin-bottom: 1rem;">
    <div class="cf-turnstile" data-language="zh-cn" data-sitekey="0x4AAAAAACzZJprJ4npD9l7W" data-callback="qlOnTurnstileSuccess"></div>
    <input class="ql-turnstile-token" type="hidden" name="captchaToken" value="">
  </div>

  <button id="ql-subscribe-submit" class="ql-btn-primary" style="width: 100%;">订阅</button>
  <p id="ql-subscribe-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" class="ql-status-msg" style="margin-top: 1rem; text-align: center;"></p>
</div>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const submitBtn = document.getElementById("ql-subscribe-submit");
  const emailInput = document.getElementById("ql-subscribe-email");
  const statusEl = document.getElementById("ql-subscribe-status");

  async function confirmFromHashIfPresent() {
    const hash = window.location.hash || "";
    if (!hash.includes("confirm=") && !window.location.search.includes("confirm=")) return;

    const hashParams = new URLSearchParams(hash.replace(/^#/, ""));
    const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const confirmToken = hashParams.get("confirm") || searchParams.get("confirm");
    if (!confirmToken) return;

    if (typeof SUPABASE_FUNCTIONS_URL === "undefined") return;

    statusEl.textContent = "正在确认您的订阅……";
    statusEl.className = "ql-status-msg";

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_FUNCTIONS_URL}/subscribe-confirm`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json"
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ token: confirmToken })
      });
      const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (!res.ok || !data.ok) throw new Error((data.error && data.error.message) || "确认失败");

      statusEl.textContent = "邮箱已确认，订阅成功！";
      statusEl.className = "ql-status-msg ql-success-text";

      window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname + window.location.search);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      statusEl.textContent = "邮箱确认失败，请重新打开确认链接。";
      statusEl.className = "ql-status-msg ql-error-text";
    }
  }

  confirmFromHashIfPresent();

  submitBtn.addEventListener("click", async () => {
    const email = emailInput.value.trim();
    const token = window.__ql_turnstile_token;

    if (typeof SUPABASE_FUNCTIONS_URL === "undefined") {
      statusEl.textContent = "订阅服务尚未配置。";
      statusEl.className = "ql-status-msg ql-error-text";
      return;
    }

    if (!email || !email.includes("@")) {
      statusEl.textContent = "请输入有效的电子邮箱地址。";
      statusEl.className = "ql-status-msg ql-error-text";
      return;
    }
    if (!token) {
      statusEl.textContent = "请完成人机验证。";
      statusEl.className = "ql-status-msg ql-error-text";
      return;
    }

    submitBtn.disabled = true;
    statusEl.textContent = "正在提交……";
    statusEl.className = "ql-status-msg";

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_FUNCTIONS_URL}/subscribe`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email, captchaToken: token })
      });
      
      const text = await res.text().catch(() => "");
      const data = text ? (() => { try { return JSON.parse(text); } catch { return {}; } })() : {};
      if (!res.ok || !data.ok) throw new Error((data.error && data.error.message) || (data.message) || `HTTP ${res.status}`);
      
      statusEl.textContent = "请查收邮件以确认订阅。";
      statusEl.className = "ql-status-msg ql-success-text";
      emailInput.value = "";
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      statusEl.textContent = "订阅失败，请重试。";
      statusEl.className = "ql-status-msg ql-error-text";
    } finally {
      submitBtn.disabled = false;
    }
  });
});
</script>
```
